title: Threshold audit probe
description: Measure accuracy on labelled examples and choose thresholds, or detect drift after a model change

question.description: the yes/no question the threshold applies to

zone.combine: high if claim >= yes_at; low if claim <= no_at; mid otherwise

limitations: reads one labelled example and reports its probability and zone against the provisional 0.05/0.95 band; the accuracy, threshold fit, N and rule-of-three bound over a labelled set are the `calibrate` tool's
drift alarm (a canary crossing 0.5, a reordered ladder, a changed model string) is a comparison of repeated probes by the caller; never tune on the canary set
fixtures are near-saturated; run-to-run spread is not a signal without think
notes: # deviation: spec 5.24: the recipe probes one example (decision report, the zone is an output); the audit itself is the calibrate tool; the question has no explicit criteria
